dict.string: ProDeck listens to your audio inputs (a Dante card, a console's USB audio, a microphone) for the SPL meter, the RTA, Auto-Follow, the stream report and multitrack recording.
ProDeck connects to ProPresenter, your sound console, Dante devices, NDI sources, Bitfocus Companion and the phones on your team over your local network.
ProDeck looks on your Desktop for sound-console show files and Dante presets you save there, to keep its routing map current.
ProDeck looks in Documents for sound-console show files you save there, to keep its routing map current.
ProDeck looks in Downloads for sound-console show files (Avantis Director saves there), to keep its routing map current.
ProDeck records multitrack audio to the drive you choose and reads console show files from USB sticks.
ProDeck can record multitrack audio to a network drive you choose.
